name: Silver Thread: Trois
source:
Do ghosts exist – or are they only imagined? Alicia Wilkershire, an exorcist who doesn’t fully believe, trusts her doubt to guide her. When a client’s mother experiences a haunting, Alicia senses something truly malevolent and rushes to investigate.

[From [url=https://spicaze.itch.io/silver-thread-episode-3]Itch.io[/url]]
